summary: Several proofs depend on `change` with no comment, on `erw … ; rfl` / `convert … using 1; rfl` closures across native wrappers, and on a `simp; rfl` in the examples. Two pieces of reasoning (the open-inclusion chain mono instance and the small-subcomplex excision iso) are copied several times instead of being factored into lemmas.
